description: Search messages across a whole guild by text and filters (author, channel, mentions, attachments, links, embeds, pinned state, message ID range). Use discord_list_messages to read one channel in order. Results come back newest first by default; a page can hold fewer than limit, so page with offset=next_offset until it is null. A new or busy guild index can answer "not ready"; the tool then fails with a retryable error that carries the retry delay in seconds. Results omit reactions. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

attachment_extension.description: Filter messages by file extension on attachments (e.g. 'png', 'pdf'; up to 100)

attachment_filename.description: Only messages with an attachment with one of these filenames (up to 100)

author_id.description: Only messages from these user IDs (up to 100)

author_type.description: Filter by author type: 'user', 'bot', 'webhook', or negated with '-' prefix (e.g. '-bot')

channel_id.description: Filter messages within specific channel or thread IDs (up to 500)

items.description: Channel snowflake ID to limit search within

content.description: Full-text query string to match inside message content

embed_provider.description: Only messages with an embed from these providers, case-sensitive, for example 'Tenor' (up to 100)

embed_type.description: Filter messages containing specific embed types: 'image', 'video', 'gif', 'sound', 'article'

guild_id.description: ID of the guild to search messages in

has.description: Filter by media attachment or item presence (e.g. 'link', 'embed', 'file', 'image', 'video', 'sound', 'sticker', 'poll') or negate with '-' (e.g. '-poll')

include_nsfw.description: Whether to include results from age-restricted (NSFW) channels (default false)

limit.description: Max number of message results per page (1-25; default is 25)

link_hostname.description: Only messages containing links to these domains (up to 100)

max_id.description: Message snowflake ID ceiling (only messages created before this snowflake ID)

mention_everyone.description: Filter whether the message mentions @everyone or @here

mentions.description: Only messages that mention these user IDs (up to 100)

mentions_role_id.description: Only messages that mention these role IDs (up to 100)

min_id.description: Message snowflake ID floor (only messages created after this snowflake ID)

offset.description: Paging offset index into search results (use next_offset to page forward)

pinned.description: Filter only pinned messages when true, or unpinned when false

replied_to_message_id.description: Only messages replying directly to these message IDs (up to 100)

replied_to_user_id.description: Only messages sent in reply to these user IDs (up to 100)

slop.description: Max words allowed between matching words of content (0-100, default 2)

sort_by.description: Sort criterion for matching messages: 'timestamp' or 'relevance' (default 'timestamp')

sort_order.description: Sort direction, 'asc' or 'desc' (default 'desc'). Ignored when sort_by is 'relevance'
